Title: Add Job with all valid mandatory fields
Preconditions: User logged in as Admin, on Jobs > All page
Testdata: Name: "John Smith"; Email: john@email.com; Phone: +61 412345678; ABN: 12345678901; Address: valid site address; Postcode: 2000; Activity: valid selection; Building type: valid selection; Method: valid selection; Own ref: REF-001; Install date: 25-08-2026; Installer: valid company
Steps: 1. Click "Add Job" 2. Fill all mandatory fields with valid data 3. Click "Send engagement letter & fact sheet"
Description: Verify job creation succeeds with complete valid data
Expected Result: Job is created successfully, engagement letter & fact sheet is sent, new Job ID appears in All Jobs list

Title: Submit form with all mandatory fields empty
Steps: 1. Open Add Job modal 2. Leave all fields empty 3. Click "Send engagement letter & fact sheet"
Description: Verify validation triggers for all required (*) fields
Expected Result: Inline red validation errors shown under each mandatory field; form does not submit

Title: Customer name field accepts valid alphabetic input
Steps: 1. Enter name in Customer name field 2. Move to next field
Description: Verify name field accepts standard text
Expected Result: Value accepted, no validation error

Title: Customer name rejects numeric/special characters
Steps: 1. Enter name with numbers/symbols 2. Tab out
Expected Result: Validation error shown, e.g. "Only letters and spaces allowed"

Title: Customer name boundary - single character
Steps: 1. Enter single character 2. Tab out
Expected Result: Error shown if min length > 1, else accepted as valid boundary

Title: Customer name boundary - max length exceeded
Steps: 1. Paste very long string into Customer name 2. Tab out
Expected Result: Input truncated at max limit or validation error shown

Title: Email field accepts valid format
Steps: 1. Enter valid email 2. Tab out
Expected Result: No validation error

Title: Email field rejects invalid format
Steps: 1. Enter each invalid email variant 2. Tab out
Description: Verify format validation on Email field
Expected Result: Validation error: "Enter a valid email address"; form not submittable

Title: Email field rejects duplicate/already-registered email
Preconditions: Existing job with email customer@email.com exists
Steps: 1. Enter duplicate email 2. Submit form
Description: Verify system handles duplicate email per business rule
Expected Result: Either error "Email already exists" or job created if duplicates are allowed (per business rule)

Title: Phone field accepts valid AU mobile number
Steps: 1. Select AU flag 2. Enter valid mobile number
Expected Result: No validation error

Title: Phone field rejects invalid/short number
Steps: 1. Enter invalid phone values 2. Tab out
Expected Result: Validation error shown; form blocked from submission

Title: Phone field boundary - exact minimum digit count
Steps: 1. Enter number at minimum valid length 2. Tab out
Expected Result: Accepted without error (if 9 digits is valid minimum)

Title: ABN/ACN accepts valid 11-digit ABN
Steps: 1. Enter valid 11-digit ABN 2. Tab out
Expected Result: No validation error

Title: ABN/ACN rejects incorrect digit count
Steps: 1. Enter ABN with fewer/more than required digits 2. Tab out
Expected Result: Validation error: "Enter a valid ABN/ACN"; form blocked

Title: ABN/ACN rejects alphabetic/special characters
Steps: 1. Enter non-numeric ABN value 2. Tab out
Expected Result: Validation error shown or characters not entered

Title: Site address autocomplete returns matching suggestions
Preconditions: On Add Job modal, address lookup service available
Steps: 1. Start typing in Site address field 2. Observe dropdown suggestions
Expected Result: Matching address suggestions appear in dropdown; selecting one populates field

Title: Site address - "Add Manual Address" toggle works when no match found
Steps: 1. Type an address not found in lookup 2. Toggle "Add Manual Address" 3. Enter manual address fields
Description: Verify fallback manual address entry works
Expected Result: Manual address fields appear and accept input; job can still be created

Title: Postcode field accepts valid 4-digit NSW postcode
Steps: 1. Enter valid postcode 2. Tab out
Expected Result: No validation error

Title: Postcode field rejects invalid format
Steps: 1. Enter invalid postcode values 2. Tab out
Expected Result: Validation error: "Enter a valid postcode"; form blocked

Title: Postcode mismatches selected Site address state
Steps: 1. Select NSW address 2. Manually enter mismatched postcode 3. Submit
Description: Verify cross-field validation between address and postcode
Expected Result: Validation error indicating postcode does not match address/state

Title: Activity type dropdown displays and allows single selection
Steps: 1. Click Activity type dropdown 2. Select an option
Description: Verify dropdown populates and selection persists
Expected Result: Selected value displayed in field; no error

Title: Building type dropdown displays and allows single selection
Steps: 1. Click Building type dropdown 2. Select an option
Description: Verify dropdown populates and selection persists
Expected Result: Selected value displayed in field; no error

Title: Method of lead generation - mandatory validation
Steps: 1. Fill all other fields 2. Leave Method dropdown blank 3. Submit
Expected Result: Validation error shown: "Please select a method"; form not submitted

Title: Own reference accepts optional/free text
Steps: 1. Enter reference text 2. Submit form
Description: Verify free text field behaves as expected (optional, no asterisk in some builds)
Expected Result: Value accepted and saved with job record

Title: Installation date accepts valid past/current date
Steps: 1. Click date picker 2. Select today's date
Description: Verify valid date format DD-MM-YYYY accepted
Expected Result: Date accepted, displayed correctly, no error

Title: Installation date rejects future date beyond allowed range
Preconditions: On Add Job modal, business rule restricts future dates
Steps: 1. Manually type or pick a far-future date 2. Tab out/submit
Expected Result: Validation error: "Installation date cannot be in the future" (if rule applies); form blocked

Title: Installation date rejects invalid/malformed input
Steps: 1. Manually type invalid date string into field 2. Tab out
Expected Result: Validation error shown; invalid value rejected

Title: Installer (company) dropdown - no installers available
Preconditions: On Add Job modal, no installer companies onboarded in system
Steps: 1. Click Installer (company) dropdown
Expected Result: Dropdown shows "No installers found" or similar empty state, does not error/crash

Title: Close modal via ""X"" without saving discards data
Preconditions: On Add Job modal with partial data entered
Steps: 1. Enter data in several fields 2. Click "X" close icon
Description: Verify unsaved data is discarded/warned on close
Expected Result: Modal closes; either confirmation prompt appears or data is discarded without saving

Title: Submit button disabled until all mandatory fields valid
Steps: 1. Fill partial mandatory fields 2. Observe "Send engagement letter & fact sheet" button state
Description: Verify button remains disabled/blocked until form is valid
Expected Result: Button is disabled or click triggers validation errors instead of submission

Title: Network/server failure during submission
Preconditions: On Add Job modal, simulate API failure/timeout
Steps: 1. Fill valid data 2. Disconnect network or mock 500 error 3. Click Send
Description: Verify graceful error handling on submission failure
Expected Result: User-friendly error message shown (e.g. "Something went wrong, please try again"); no duplicate job created

Title: SQL Injection / script injection in text fields
Steps: 1. Enter malicious script/SQL strings in text fields 2. Submit
Description: Verify input sanitization and security handling
Expected Result: Input is sanitized/escaped or rejected; no script execution, no backend error
